Name: v1.4 Misc Recolour Pack (Fish Pond Craftables Scarecrow and Dresser)
Author: DustBeauty
Description:
[b]A misc recolour pack, mostly covers the newly added 1.4 content.[/b]
____________________________________________________________________

[b].[/b] Seasonal fish pond and seasonal deluxe scarecrow. Including a recolour version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5301]Gwen's fish pond[/url]﻿, you must download the original for it to show in your
  game. Config option to toggle off the fish pond.

[b]. [/b]Smeg mini-fridge, Industrial style workbench, crystalarium, and wood chipper are designed to match with my released [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5351]Industrial Kitchen[/url] and my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916?tab=user+images]upcoming Industrial furniture set[/url].

[b]. [/b]Wooden garden pot, worm bin and more realistic looking basic log and log section you can buy at Robin. Config option to toggle off the garden pot.

[b]. [/b]Bang & Olufsen Beogram turntable replaces the Jukebox.

[b]. [/b]PS4Pro replaces the Junimo Kart Arcade System, PS4 replaces the new Cursed P.K. Arcade (possibly a cut content, which can only be obtained through item     
  spawner and works as decor.)

[b]. [/b]A mirror sprite to replace the dresser for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4734]Customize Anywhere[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044]Get Glam[/url]﻿. Search the corresponding file name in their /assets folder("big-craftable" for CA, "dresser" for GG) and replace them.

[b]The optional file is the pond water recolour package, a more realistic and desaturated colour template that differs based on the fish type. Require MouseyPounds' [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4703]Pond Painter[/url][b]﻿ to work.

[/b][b]The beach map is made by me, edited based on Hidden Spirit Cove Farm, included in an upcoming story expansion mod.[/b]
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
[u]Recommend to use with [/u][b][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3063]Yellog's Wood craftables[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3063]Scarecrow and Rarecrow Recolors[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2533?tab=files&file_id=10233]Owl Scarecrows CP Conversion[/url]﻿.[/u][/b]
